answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Merlin keeper goshawk mark flown at the mews, and every verdict reads the same way: each goshawk is a season of logged flights plus a signed mews record. The opal says who, the trellis says how much, the grove says how long — and of the three, the farm fears the last answer most. A mask waits 10 days after paying 228 POA; a farm waits 10 days for each mask after paying 36936 POA. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins have gone. Honest proof grows from seed; farm proof is sawdust on the workshop floor.
